items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: Surgeys and Wilder. I knew it was a colored club though.

ctx.x: You could have hired Jack Lane's band.

Oh I didn't know man. I had the letter here. If I could find that letter and let you read that letter. It was really funny man. It had the funnies in that. Surgeys and Wilder. I knew it was a colored club though. But the man sure wrote a nice letter and said, how much you like the band. You know, we, we were playing out here at that time. I got that letter out there. I used to broadcast over at WWL a whole lot. You know. And, uh. He wanted us to come up there and play, play that dance. But. Never did get to make…
background was mostly from my, uh, uh, mother's side.
